detailed_description: Open Graph Preview shows how a page's Open Graph and Twitter Card metadata will look as a shared card. In Manual mode you fill in title, description, image URL, page URL, and site name to drive the preview. In Fetch mode you enter a URL and the tool fetches the HTML through the public allorigins.win proxy, then reads og:title, og:description, og:image, og:site_name, and og:url (with title and meta description as fallbacks). The preview can be rendered in three styles - Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn - and the page also generates an Open Graph + Twitter Card meta tag snippet with a Copy button. The tool does not validate against social platform debuggers, simulate device viewports, support drag-and-drop image uploads, or persist past entries.
usage_steps: Pick Manual mode and fill in title, description, image URL, page URL, and site name; or pick Fetch mode and paste a full http(s) URL
In Fetch mode click Fetch to load the page through the allorigins proxy and populate the fields
Switch between the Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn buttons to see different card layouts
Review the preview card and the read-only summary of fetched values
Click Copy under the Generated Code panel to copy the OG and Twitter Card meta tag snippet
Paste the snippet into your page's <head> and verify with the official social platform debuggers
usage_examples: Sketch a blog post share card in Manual mode and copy the meta tag snippet into the page template
Fetch a live URL to see what title, description, and image its current OG tags actually expose
Compare how the same metadata renders across the Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn previews
Iterate on a custom title and image until the preview looks right before publishing
